rows.grounds: genitive relation indicating possession; refers to the Īśāna aspect of Śiva
object of arrangement; the kalās associated with Īśāna
compound qualifying kalāḥ; praṇava kept as mantra term
prescriptive injunction to arrange or assign the kalās

items.question: What number and initial element define the kalās to be arranged for Īśāna?
premises: Īśāna has kalās that are to be arranged.
The kalās belonging to Īśāna are five in number.
These five kalās begin with the praṇava.
items.inference: Therefore one should arrange five kalās for Īśāna beginning with the praṇava.
uncertainties: The specific identities of the five kalās are not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should arrange the five kalās of Īśāna, beginning with the praṇava.
